name: cyanheads-mcp-server
description: Fleet discovery for the cyanheads MCP ecosystem — semantic search + install snippets.

catalog_url.title: Catalog URL
catalog_url.description: Remote fleet.json endpoint (schema v2 with baked embeddings), as an absolute URL. Defaults to the canonical cyanheads fleet — override to point at your own hosted catalog.

catalog_fetch_timeout_ms.title: Catalog Fetch Timeout
catalog_fetch_timeout_ms.description: Per-request timeout for fleet.json fetches in milliseconds. Must be greater than 0.

catalog_refresh_seconds.title: Catalog Refresh Interval
catalog_refresh_seconds.description: Background poll interval for fleet.json refreshes in seconds. Set to 0 to disable background refresh.

embedding_model_id.title: Embedding Model ID
embedding_model_id.description: Hugging Face model id for query embedding. Must match fleet.json.embeddingModel.

similarity_floor.title: Similarity Floor
similarity_floor.description: Cosine similarity cutoff for cyanheads_search_catalog results. Must be within [0, 1] — raise to require closer matches; lower to surface more candidates.
